channel.title: vuvi.org — Making presentations with AI
channel.description: Practical, no-hype guides on creating presentations with AI: real workflows, copy-paste prompts, honest tool advice. For people who present at work.

item.title: 8 Mistakes People Make with AI Presentations
item.description: The eight failure modes of AI decks — each with its symptom, its cause, and the fix in practice — plus the 60-second self-audit before any deck ships.

item.title: One Deck, Ten Assets: Repurposing Presentations with AI
item.description: Eight prompts that turn a finished deck into memos, emails, posts and FAQs — one source of truth, consistent numbers everywhere, no rewriting from memory.

item.title: Use AI for Speaker Notes, Rehearsals and Q&A Prep
item.description: Notes in your voice, three rounds of rehearsal against a machine audience, and the Q&A bank built before anyone asks — including the three honest "I don't know" forms.

item.title: Design Mistakes AI Still Makes (and Quick Fixes)
item.description: Five fixes with the biggest visual return — bullets, hierarchy, imagery, consistency, charts — a 15-minute order of operations, and the chart-type table that ends pie-chart abuse.

item.title: The Human Pass: How to Edit AI-Generated Slides
item.description: The 25-minute edit pass, in leverage order: story first, then specificity, deletion, verification, read-aloud — with the so-what test and a label-vs-takeaway title table.

item.title: 10 Prompt Templates for Every Presentation Type
item.description: Fill-in-the-blank prompts for sales decks, QBRs, kickoffs, training, talks, demos, investor updates, webinars, proposals and all-hands — each with when to use, how to adapt, what to check.

item.title: How to Turn a Document into a Presentation with AI
item.description: The four-step method for turning a 12-page report into a 10-slide deck: prepare, extract, filter, compress — with the prompts, a worked example, and the paraphrase-trap check.

item.title: AI Presentation Tools Compared: What Each One Is Actually Good At
item.description: Chat AIs, Gamma, Copilot, Canva, Beautiful.ai, Plus AI, Napkin — what each is good at, four selection scenarios, the day-one export test, and what none of them do.

item.title: The Prompt Formula: How to Ask AI for Slides That Actually Work
item.description: A seven-part prompt formula with a symptom-to-fix troubleshooting table, one topic × three audiences, and the ten follow-up prompts that do the real work.

item.title: My 30-Minute Workflow for Creating a Presentation with AI
item.description: The three-pass system — brief, outline, slides — with the full prompt set, a worked example with an honest time log, and the three ways the workflow itself breaks.
